description: §55.17.3 over a declaration's child field: the invalid submit runs no handler, sets the COMPOUND's submitted and the field's touched (§55.7); the compound reads invalid (§55.5).
rationale: §55.17.3: the gate marks "touched = true on every bound validated value of the form — every value that carries validators (a validated top-level value, §55.5.1, or a validated child field of a declaration) …", then "Set submitted = true on those values (top-level) and on the compounds that own them (child fields)", then blocks. "Declaration forms are gated exactly like forms that bind top-level values".
